# Nimmee

> Nimmee is the AI brand and growth manager for local businesses, run from WhatsApp. It is launching soon and is not open yet. A waitlist is open.

## What it is being built to do
- Remember your business: offers, hours, tone and what customers keep asking. Confirmed by the owner, stored per business, always editable.
- Run your brand: a brand kit, then a steady stream of posts that look like the business, scheduled once the owner approves them.
- Catch every lead: customer messages and follow-ups in one inbox, with replies drafted from what it knows about the business.
- Work on WhatsApp: voice onboarding, approvals and alerts in the app owners already use, plus a light web view for calendar, leads and brand kit.

## Owner control
- Posts and replies wait for the owner's approval before anything goes out.
- The owner can see, edit and delete everything Nimmee knows about the business.
- No lock-in: the brand kit and content stay with the owner.

## Status
- Not launched. No public pricing, clients or customer results exist yet.
